fusions.name: Kick and Scatter
fusions.desc: A backward kick that deals 12 damage, leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds and knocks it back 3.5 tiles. Your movement speed rises by 20% for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Blind Flap
fusions.desc: Flaps in a panic, dealing 6 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles. Its damage rises 6% for every tenth of your health already gone, up to 30%. It holds 3 charges, and a kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Bolting Flutter
fusions.desc: Bolts 4 tiles forward in a flutter of wings, and your movement speed rises by 20% for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Startle Reflex
fusions.desc: Every time you avoid a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 5. The next ability you use spends them all: you deal 6% more damage per stack for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
